Metadata.title: Plainly — Paperwork, in plain language
Metadata.description: Turn leases, visa letters and contracts into a plain summary, the actions you owe and their deadlines. Every point comes with a quote from the document.

Common.notLegalAdvice: Plainly explains documents. It is not legal advice.

Footer.note: Not legal advice. Files are deleted after 30 days.

Landing.eyebrow: Leases, visa letters, job offers, contracts
Landing.sub: Drop in a document. See what it says, what you have to do, and by when. Every point links to the line it came from.
Landing.how1Body: A PDF, a photo of a letter, or pasted text. Up to 20 pages.
Landing.how2Body: A short summary, the key facts and the terms that matter, in the language you read best.
Landing.how3Body: Your to-dos with dates, ready to drop into your calendar.
Landing.featTitleMuted: Each one shows where it came from.
Landing.featQuoteBody: Each fact points to its page and the exact sentence. If the quote isn't in your document, Plainly drops the claim.
Landing.featDeadlinesBody: A date appears only when the document states it.
Landing.featWatchBody: The clauses that can cost you, from critical down to good to know.
Landing.featChatBody: Answers come from the document only. If it isn't in there, Plainly tells you.
Landing.privBody: Plainly reads your file to explain it, and keeps it no longer than it needs to.
Landing.priv1: Files sit in private storage. Only you can open them.
Landing.priv2: Everything is deleted after 30 days, or right away with one button.
Landing.priv3: Document text never goes into logs or analytics.
Landing.priv4: This is not legal advice. Plainly explains what the document says, and the decision is yours.
Landing.faq1A: No. Plainly explains what a document says and points to the exact lines. For decisions with legal weight, talk to a professional.
Landing.faq2A: PDFs, photos (PNG, JPG) and pasted text, up to 10 MB and 20 pages. Leases, visa and residence letters, job offers, bank notices and contracts work best.
Landing.faq3Q: What if my document is in another language?
Landing.faq3A: Upload it as it is. You choose whether the explanation comes back in English, French or Chinese.
Landing.faq4Q: How do I know it didn't make things up?
Landing.faq4A: Each point carries a quote. Plainly checks that the quote really is in your document and removes any point that fails the check.
Landing.faq5A: No. You get 8 credits straight away, enough for a short document and a few questions. Create a free account to keep your documents and get 24 credits every month.

Landing.finalBody: Try a sample first. It takes ten seconds.

Landing.pricingRead: Reading your results is always free

Privacy.title: Privacy, in plain language
Privacy.lead: You trust Plainly with documents that matter. Here is exactly what happens to them.
Privacy.store1: The file you upload, in a private storage bucket only your account can read.
Privacy.store2: The analysis and your chat messages about that document.
Privacy.store3: A daily count of analyses, to apply the free limit.
Privacy.howLong: Documents are deleted automatically after your plan's retention period: 7 days as a guest, 30 days on Free, 180 days on Pro. You can delete everything sooner with one click.
Privacy.who: Only you. To write the explanation, the document text is sent to the AI provider we use: {providers}. Its API does not train on your data. Document text is never written to logs or analytics.
Privacy.legal: Plainly explains what a document says. It does not tell you whether something is legal or what you should sign.
Privacy.deleteBody: Removes all your documents, analyses, chats and deadlines. This can't be undone.
Privacy.confirmBody: All documents, analyses, chats and deadlines will be removed for good.
Privacy.deleteFailed: Deletion didn't complete. Please try again.
Privacy.processorsLead: These companies process data for us, only to run Plainly:
Privacy.processorSupabase: Supabase: database, file storage and sign-in.
Privacy.processorAi: {providers}: reads the document text to write the explanation and answers.
Privacy.processorCloudflare: Cloudflare Turnstile: checks that a visitor is a person before anything is stored.
Privacy.processorResend: Resend: sends sign-in codes and account emails.
Privacy.processorSentry: Sentry: error reports, without document text or personal details.
Privacy.processorBilling: Our payment provider, when you buy a plan or a pack. Plainly never sees your card details.
Privacy.rights: You can export all your data or delete your account from the Account page at any time. For any other request, write to us from the email of your account and we answer within 30 days.

LandingDemo.docTitle: Residential lease — 14 Rue des Lilas, Lyon
LandingDemo.summary: A 12-month lease in Lyon from 1 December 2026. Rent is €850 plus €60 charges a month, with a €1,700 deposit due by 20 November. It renews every year unless you send three months' notice by registered letter.
LandingDemo.watch1Body: Send notice three months before the end date.
LandingDemo.quote: The Tenant shall pay a security deposit of €1,700 no later than 20 November 2026.
LandingDemo.chatA1: Only with the landlord's written consent.

Pricing.title: Plans for every pile of paperwork
Pricing.lead: A credit is a unit of work. A 5-page analysis uses 3, a question uses 1. Reading your results is always free.
Pricing.packLine: Need more now? {credits} credits for {price}, and they never expire.
Pricing.faq_credits_a: An analysis uses 1 credit plus 2 for every 5 pages. A question uses 1, a deep answer 3. Samples, repeated uploads and anything that fails are free.
Pricing.faq_refunds_a: Yes, within 14 days of a purchase, for credits you haven't used. Write to us from your account email.
Pricing.faq_data_a: They're private to you and deleted after your plan's retention period. You can export or delete everything at any time.
Pricing.faq_cancel_a: Yes. A paid plan stays active until the end of the period you paid for, then you move to Free. Nothing is deleted.
Pricing.faq_reading_q: What if I run out of credits?
Pricing.faq_reading_a: Your documents, explanations, deadlines and chats stay readable. Only new analyses and questions wait for credits.
Pricing.maxTag: For long documents and heavy use
Pricing.free_6: Credit packs when you need more
Pricing.pro_4: Explanations in English, French and Chinese
Pricing.max_4: Documents kept for a full year
Pricing.note1: Credits reset every month. How fast you use them depends on how long your documents are and how many questions you ask.
Pricing.note2: Prices in US dollars. Taxes are added at checkout where they apply.
Pricing.note3: Need more than Max? Write to us from your account email.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.lead: The rules for using Plainly, in plain words.
Terms.service: Plainly explains documents you upload: a summary, key facts, things to do with their dates, and points to watch, each with a quote from the document. You can ask questions about the document.
Terms.account: You must be 16 or older. Keep your sign-in email safe; you are responsible for what is done with your account. You can delete it at any time.
Terms.credits: AI work uses credits. Plans grant credits each month; unused plan credits do not carry over. Pack credits never expire. Prices are shown before you pay, and our payment provider handles taxes and invoices.
Terms.refunds: You can ask for a refund within 14 days of a purchase for credits you haven't used. A cancelled plan stays active until the end of the paid period.
Terms.use: Upload only documents you have the right to share. Don't use Plainly to break the law, to overload the service, or to get around limits with many accounts.
Terms.advice: Plainly explains what a document says. It does not tell you whether something is legal or whether to sign. For decisions that matter, ask a qualified professional.
Terms.ai: Every claim comes with a quote you can check, and claims we can't verify are removed. Still, check important dates and amounts against the original.
Terms.content: Your documents stay yours. We use them only to provide the service, never to train AI models, and delete them as described in the Privacy policy.
Terms.liability: We work hard to keep Plainly accurate and available, but we provide it as is. As far as the law allows, our liability is limited to what you paid us in the last 12 months.
Terms.ending: You can stop at any time by deleting your account. We may suspend accounts that break these terms, and we tell you why.
Terms.changes: If these terms change, we show the new version and its date here and ask you to accept it the next time you sign in.
Terms.contact: Questions about these terms? Write to us from the email of your account.
